text: {"overall_winner": "A", "qualities": [{"evidence": "Organized into distinct body paragraphs introduced by key sub-arguments (\"PRACTICE.MAKES.PERFECT.\", \"Do something different from everybody else.\", and \"At the end of all of your hard work...\").", "quality": "Structural Organization", "description": "Captures the clear division of ideas into logical, well-sequenced paragraphs that guide the reader through the essay."}, {"evidence": "Uses transitions such as \"Furthermore\", \"At the start\", \"However\", \"Two months later\", and \"In conclusion\" to connect ideas across sentences.", "quality": "Cohesive Devices", "description": "Captures the appropriate use of transitional words and phrases to create smooth connections between thoughts."}, {"evidence": "Includes relevant personal anecdotes about trying out for a basketball team and taking an online high school course to support theoretical claims.", "quality": "Elaboration and Evidence", "description": "Captures the development of core claims through detailed, relevant examples and narrative illustrations."}, {"evidence": "Maintains a consistent argument addressing the prompt's quote from start to finish, including a addressed counterargument paragraph.", "quality": "Topical Focus and Progression", "description": "Captures the ability to stay focused on a central line of reasoning while fully addressing opposing viewpoints."}]}
